svg.title: Infini rainbow metal emblem — reference-matched proportions, widened 50%
svg.desc: Rounded broad loops widened 50% horizontally and made 25% taller to better match the emblem reference, continuous one-turn rainbow from leftmost red, varied pigments and a metallic gunmetal rim. Transparent background.
